feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Former special counsel Jack Smith defends investigation into Trump on Capitol Hill
entry.summary: Former Justice Department special counsel Jack Smith defended two criminal indictments against President Trump on Capitol Hill.

entry.title: What's behind HHS claims that gender-affirming care 'may' radicalize
entry.summary: The report is the agency's latest effort to chip away at trust in established health care models for transgender people. Critics say it frames transgender identity as illegitimate or even dangerous.

entry.title: Outside groups are spending millions on races that could determine Senate control
entry.summary: New Hampshire's Senate race is one of a handful that could determine control of Congress next year. That's why outside money groups are plowing big money into it — some $50 million to date.

entry.title: Retired general who led troops in Iraq warns U.S. exit may give Iran, ISIS an opening
entry.summary: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, who commanded U.S. troops in Iraq, says the withdrawal could strengthen Iran and leave Iraq more vulnerable to ISIS.

entry.title: Trump says top tech firms have signed accord to 'self-police' AI development
entry.summary: President Trump on Tuesday said that he and a large group of leaders of artificial intelligence companies had signed a voluntary accord that will include internal and external reviews.

entry.title: N.Y. Sen. Gillibrand says new allegations in Cornell case are 'serious and horrific'
entry.summary: NPR's Juana Summers talks with New York Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand about the reopening of the rape case at Cornell University, and her history of pushing legislation to curb campus sexual assault.

entry.title: Potential Taiwan tension sparked 'last minute' change in Trump-Xi National Archives visit
entry.summary: The sudden change was precipitated because of Chinese displeasure over one document that the U.S. had planned to show.

entry.title: Trump administration says it's scaling back fuel efficiency standards for new cars
entry.summary: The Trump administration is weakening Biden-era fuel efficiency standards for new cars and trucks.

entry.title: News organizations ask court to bar White House enforcement of access ban
entry.summary: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

entry.title: The Senate passes the Protect College Sports Act, but the bill's future is unclear
entry.summary: The bill's supporters, which include the NCAA, say it will tame what they call a "Wild West" era of college sports as litigation chips away at long-held rules around eligibility, transfers and pay.
